feeds.title: Kids in the Capital
feeds.description: Kids in the Capital is an Ottawa-based parenting blog where you can learn about local activities, attractions, and events, as well as parenting tips and tricks. The key is that the content on Kids in the Capital is written by parents for parents from a first-hand perspective.

feeds.title: The Rebel Mama Podcast
feeds.description: A weekly podcast that blows the lid off modern parenthood by bestselling authors and O.G. mommy-group drop outs, Nikita Stanley and Aleks Jassem. Expect short episodes, hot topics, great guests, audience participation and an all 'round good time.

feeds.title: The Best of This Life
feeds.description: The Best Of This Life was started by Emily Smith, in 2011. She covers a wide range of lifestyle topics such as recipes, fashion, home decor, family, motherhood, and local events. As a devoted wife and mother of two, She is committed to using the highest quality brands, products, and methods in her everyday life, and she carries this integrity into her writing.

feeds.title: Sara McConnell Photography Blog
feeds.description: Sara McConnell is an Ottawa photographer who specializes in baby, family, maternity, and newborn photography. Read her blog to know what it feels like to be a family photographer, and photography sessions and classes.

feeds.title: Stephanie de Montigny Blog
feeds.description: The adventure I call life has taken me along the ride of being an educator, worldly traveler, amateur foodie, web guru, creative photographer, and most recently becoming a mom. The lifestyle blog allows me to be able to share the wins and struggles of being a work-from-home boss, my family's big and small moments, and help other mamas one step at a time through their journey.

feeds.title: Butterfly Run Ottawa Blog
feeds.description: Our vision is to support Ottawa and area families who have experienced infertility, a loss during pregnancy or the loss of an infant. We are ensuring that our community has the resources to provide parents and families with the care they so desperately need.

feeds.title: Urban Bent Studio Blog
feeds.description: I'm Christine, an Ottawa maternity, newborn, and family photographer. As a mom and grandmother myself, I understand the importance of creating timeless images that will be heirlooms for future generations to treasure.

feeds.title: Unstoppable Mama Blog
feeds.description: The author of the blog is a mom to Theo and Stella, her energetic kids. Unstoppable Mama blog is where Sara shares ideas and connects with others in the Unstoppable Community. She wants to help kids grow strong and make communities better.

feeds.title: Mom's Homemade
feeds.description: Cheryl has been making salsa for a long time, she's been refining the recipe and sharing the results with family and friends. Read her recipes, check out pictures, and more.

feeds.title: The Sweetest Digs
feeds.description: The Sweetest Digs is all about creating a stylish and simple home. Decorating, simplifying, and creating an all-natural home is my jam. I firmly believe that white paint can solve just about anything.

feeds.title: A Little Bit of Momsense
feeds.description: A Little Bit of Momsense is a parenting and lifestyle blog by Rebecca Stanisic. She covers stories about parenting, family-friendly activities, yummy recipes, family travel, and living a life full of love and laughter.
